# BentoPDF Project Guidelines

## Architecture

- BentoPDF is a Vite multi-page static app with client-side PDF processing only (no backend).
- Root marketing/category pages live at repo root (e.g. [index.html](index.html), [pdf-converter.html](pdf-converter.html)); tool pages live in [src/pages](src/pages).
- Tool logic follows the pattern [src/pages/<tool>.html](src/pages) + [src/js/logic/<tool>-page.ts](src/js/logic). Shared bootstrapping is in [src/js/main.ts](src/js/main.ts) and [src/js/mobileMenu.ts](src/js/mobileMenu.ts).
- Shared upload/dispatch and tool routing are centralized:
  - [src/js/handlers/fileHandler.ts](src/js/handlers/fileHandler.ts)
  - [src/js/config/pdf-tools.ts](src/js/config/pdf-tools.ts) (`singlePdfLoadTools`, `multiFileTools`, `simpleTools`)
- Tool catalog and homepage cards are defined in [src/js/config/tools.ts](src/js/config/tools.ts).
- Use Web Workers from [public/workers](public/workers) and reference them via `import.meta.env.BASE_URL + 'workers/<name>.worker.js'`.

## Build And Test

- Install: `npm install`
- Dev server: `npm run dev`
- Build: `npm run build`
- Preview build: `npm run preview`
- Lint: `npm run lint`
- Tests: `npm run test` (watch) or `npm run test:run` (CI-style)
- Important: `npm run build` already includes TypeScript compile, i18n page generation, and sitemap generation.

## i18n And Routing

- i18n uses i18next with `data-i18n` attributes and locale JSON files under [public/locales](public/locales).
- Keep translations and tool metadata aligned, especially [public/locales/en/tools.json](public/locales/en/tools.json).
- Build-time localization is generated by [scripts/generate-i18n-pages.mjs](scripts/generate-i18n-pages.mjs), which creates localized files under `dist/<lang>/`.
- Language routing and page flattening behavior are defined in [vite.config.ts](vite.config.ts).

## HTML And Partials

- Tool pages should use Handlebars partials from [src/partials](src/partials) (`{{> navbar }}` and `{{> footer }}`) instead of duplicating nav/footer markup.
- If shared partial markup changes, update via [scripts/update-partials.js](scripts/update-partials.js) when needed.

## Tool-Addition Checklist

- Add the new page and logic module:
  - [src/pages/<tool>.html](src/pages)
  - [src/js/logic/<tool>-page.ts](src/js/logic)
- Ensure the page loads the correct module script.
- Register the tool entry in [src/js/config/tools.ts](src/js/config/tools.ts).
- Add/align i18n keys in [public/locales/en/tools.json](public/locales/en/tools.json) (and other locales as applicable).
- Add the tool ID to the correct routing bucket in [src/js/config/pdf-tools.ts](src/js/config/pdf-tools.ts).

## Environment Toggles

- `BASE_URL=/subpath/`
- `SIMPLE_MODE=true`
- `VITE_USE_CDN=true`
- `COMPRESSION_MODE=g|b|o|all`
